value_portfolio.title: School Governance System v1.0
value_portfolio.problem_statement: The school needs one durable, low-bureaucracy management system that preserves director accountability, AI autonomy, evidence and independent assurance across chats and projects.
value_portfolio.benefit_hypothesis: A canonical governance system will reduce forgotten work, duplicate initiatives, false completion, unnecessary director involvement and uncontrolled risk.
value_portfolio.expected_capability: Consistent portfolio, service, canon, research and incident governance.

value_portfolio.title: School Canonical Bidding Engine
value_portfolio.problem_statement: The school cannot yet reliably model an auction from the acting player's information set using a complete, versioned and traceable school canon.
value_portfolio.benefit_hypothesis: A school-owned engine backed by School Canon and World Knowledge will produce reproducible bids and explanations without silently inventing school rules.
value_portfolio.expected_capability: Model and explain bidding from hand plus public auction state.

value_portfolio.title: School Autopilot Controller v1
value_portfolio.problem_statement: External waits currently end an ordinary ChatGPT turn and force the school director to act as a manual scheduler by repeatedly sending continuation commands without making a substantive decision.
value_portfolio.benefit_hypothesis: A durable event-driven controller using the existing Vercel, Neon, GitHub and Oracle stack will continue eligible technical tasks to factual completion or a real owner boundary while reducing model turns and director intervention.
value_portfolio.expected_capability: Durable bounded task execution across external waits with canonical state, evidence, cost controls and explicit owner boundaries.
value_portfolio.baseline: Chat-driven technical work commonly stops after one step or an external wait and requires another director message.
value_portfolio.target: One command advances a bounded task until DONE, OWNER_REQUIRED, FAILED_CLOSED, BUDGET_STOP or CANCELLED.
value_portfolio.cost_boundary: No new fixed subscription; reuse existing Vercel Pro, Neon, GitHub and Oracle; OpenAI API pilot hard cap USD 20.

service_portfolio.title: Research Lab Service
service_portfolio.service_level: Best effort within existing compute and governance boundaries
dependencies: Google Drive where source evidence is required
service_portfolio.recovery_requirement: Research evidence must not exist only on ephemeral compute.

service_portfolio.title: School Canon Knowledge Service
service_portfolio.service_owner: AI Management System as delegated canon steward
service_portfolio.service_level: Authoritative only for explicitly active canonical knowledge
service_portfolio.recovery_requirement: Canon versions, provenance and activation history must be recoverable and never depend on chat memory.

service_portfolio.title: Bidding Engine Service
service_portfolio.service_level: Research and validation only until canonical coverage and activation gates pass
dependencies: DDS and research engines where explicitly advisory
service_portfolio.recovery_requirement: Rules, activations, traces and provenance must be reconstructable without chat memory.

service_portfolio.title: Video Processing Service
service_portfolio.service_level: Explicit-request, canary-first, shadow-review only until independent promotion gates pass
service_portfolio.recovery_requirement: Source identity, queue state and accepted evidence must survive worker restart and must not exist only on Oracle local disk.
improvement_backlog: complete diarization and speaker-role field gate
bind queue and quality metrics to Observatory

service_portfolio.title: Reliability and Recovery Service
service_portfolio.service_level: Fail closed when recovery credentials, workload state or host evidence are unknown
service_portfolio.recovery_requirement: At least one bounded recovery path must remain available and be proven without exposing credentials.

service_portfolio.title: School Systems Observability Service
service_portfolio.service_level: Read-only evidence preferred; incomplete or stale inventory is never reported as complete
service_portfolio.recovery_requirement: Canonical summaries must be reproducible from primary sources and versioned registries.
improvement_backlog: bind service metrics to daily management summary
add freshness and primary-source drift checks
